summary: Short, very steep corner kerb with a house 5 m away and No Stopping.

drivers.seclusion: House 5 m from the start and another 12 m away; open to view.
drivers.access_and_room: Line cuts across the junction mouth; no clear room beside the lane.
drivers.traffic: Busy junction of Harts Road; cars park on the side street only.
drivers.convention: No Stopping Any Time sign on the stretch.

sun_shade: Mostly open; trees to the north-east.
